basic_profile.bio: Hello fellow trainers! I'm a 29-year-old IT specialist living in Austin, Texas. A Pokémon Go enthusiast who loves to maximize both my virtual and real-world adventures. When I'm not catching Pokémon or gifting friends, I'm probably working on my Ford F-150 Lightning or exploring the latest woodcarving techniques. My typical online hours are in the evenings during weekdays and sporadically throughout the weekend. I'm in a committed relationship, and we both share a love for craft beers and outdoor activities.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Information Technology and work as an IT specialist. My deep dive into car modifications and maintenance comes from years of self-teaching and hands-on experience with my F-150 Lightning. My woodcarving skills have been honed over the past few years, starting as a casual hobby and growing into a more serious passion. I stay updated with the latest trends in craft beers through local Austin breweries and community events.
